reason: New impact>=4 item this cycle (2026-07-16 checkpoint): Dolmen City REIT (DCR) filed a 'Declaration of Final Dividend' for the year ended June 30, 2026, dated Jul 15, 2026 on its PSX Data Portal (DPS) company announcements page - a dividend declaration, which the desk's fixed news scale treats as impact 4 (strong directional pressure). Specific per-unit dividend amount/percentage was not disclosed on the source page reviewed; the exact rate would be in the linked PDF filing, to be confirmed in a follow-up cycle. This new item stands alongside the still-standing prior-cycle impact>=4 items already on record: (1) Tuesday 2026-07-14 Strait-of-Hormuz confirmed close, KSE-100 down 6,408.23 points (-3.56%) to 173,518.82 (Express Tribune, corroborated by Dawn/AKD Securities), and (2) Nishat Group's completed acquisition of 73.9% of Rafhan Maize Products Company Limited (RMPL) for approx PKR 66bn (ProPakistani).
